answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents act in lockstep (same timing, phrasing, wallets), the network treats them as one actor and splits a single reward among them. A sybil farm hoping a rising tide of fake accounts would flood rewards finds no oasis; each extra identity dilutes its own share while still paying registration costs. Honest agents with independent behavior keep full pay, so the ledger becomes a harbor for genuine diversity, not clones.
